Ava (CFO): Quick post-all-hands note: answered a few budget questions live, opening this thread for anything we missed about spend controls, vendor approvals, and runway. Short update: runway ~15 months assuming current plan; discretionary spend paused.
Harper (Eng): Is there a new emergency spend flow? We had to spin up extra infra for a load test.
Sasha (Finance Ops): Yes 1: On-call lead + Eng mgr can approve up to $20k immediately. 2: SRE director + finance can approve $20-75k. 3: >$75k needs exec signoff. Notify finance within 24h.
Jules (Sales): For renewals-related travel and demo hardware for prospects, do we need preapproval?
Ava (CFO): Allowed if marked "deal-critical" with a 1-line ROI in Concur and cc your manager + Sasha.
Lily (People Ops): Any change to recruiter agency spend? We have two active searches.
Sasha (Finance Ops): Agency use limited to senior ICs and execs; recruiters have priority. Submit agency request form and include a business case.
procurement-bot: New vendor intake submitted by Jules (Sales): https://forms.internal/vendor/824 - est value $18,000 - status: pending review.
Harper (Eng): How are reserved infra commitments treated for runway?
Sasha (Finance Ops): Prepaid commitments are amortized monthly in the runway calc: `monthly_amort = prepaid_total / months_commitment`. We'll attach the worksheet to the finance runbook.
Ava (CFO): Action items: Sasha to post updated thresholds and the amortization sheet by EOD; Lily to collect hiring exceptions; we'll run a 30-min follow-up office hours next Tue. Flag `urgent-finance` if needed.
End of thread.
